Audio Forge bundles unmodified FFmpeg and ffprobe executables from the
BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds project.

Build: FFmpeg n8.1.2-51-g7ba069f4f1, Windows x86_64, LGPL static variant
Build release: https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases/tag/autobuild-2026-09-08-23-15
Build scripts: https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds
FFmpeg source: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/7ba069f4f1
FFmpeg project: https://ffmpeg.org/

The preparation script verifies the downloaded archive using its pinned
SHA-256 digest and copies the license supplied with that build into this
directory before packaging.
